projects.summary: The searchable project directory for this account. Every card is rendered from the project-meta.json a repository carries, so the page cannot claim anything the repository does not; a scheduled workflow rebuilds it from the live metadata every week.
key_features: One searchable page over every public repository, with filters by category and language, in Turkish and English, light and dark, each card with a preview copied from the repository's own media block
Every card is linkable by the repository's name (#repo-name), which is what most repositories use as their homepage
Generated from each repository's own project-meta.json, never hand-edited
The interface shell follows the reader's language and remembers the choice; project descriptions stay in the language their own metadata is written in
A null field is left off the page rather than filled in with a guess, and a test suite holds that line
An Atom feed, a sitemap and a schema.org ItemList written by the same run, so machines can follow the account too
Rebuilt weekly by a workflow that commits only when the output changes

social.headline: Every repository on the account, in one searchable page, generated from the metadata each one carries.
